description: excel-control harness export manifest. Single source of truth for which files the vba-sync addin ships into a project. Consumed by RefreshHarnessPayload (build time: src files -> CustomXMLPart) and WriteHarness (runtime: CustomXMLPart -> dst). 'src' is relative to excel-control/; 'dst' is relative to the exported repo root. The harness deploys as a self-contained Claude Code skill under .claude/skills/excel-control/; per-session runtime files are created at runtime under <repo>/.excel-control/ and are not deployed.
